feeds.title: Feed or website URLs
feeds.description: RSS, Atom, RDF or JSON Feed URLs. A website URL also works: the feed is auto-discovered from its HTML or from common paths (/feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /index.xml).

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Keep at most this many items from each feed, after filters and dedupe.

since.title: Only items published after
since.description: Optional ISO date or date-time, for example 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T08:00:00Z. Items without a publication date are skipped when this is set.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional. Keep only items whose title or summary contains at least one of these words or phrases (case-insensitive).

dedupe.title: Remove duplicates
dedupe.description: Skip items already seen in this run, matched by guid or link across all feeds.

includeContent.title: Include full content
includeContent.description: Add the full article body (content:encoded, Atom content, JSON Feed content) as plain text in the content field.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per request (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a request after this many seconds.
